applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along overhead electric line (southeastern corner)
findings.comment: Mitigation trees are located 0-5 feet north of the overhead electric line along the southern property boundary. Plant schedule proposes Cedar Elm and Live Oak; neither species is designated as utility-compatible (UC) per ECM Appendix F. Minimum 15-foot clearance from non-utility-compatible tree trunks to distribution conductors is required; proposed trees fall short by 10-15 feet.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along overhead electric line (southeastern corner)
findings.comment: Proposed Cedar Elm (10 trees) and Live Oak (2 trees) have typical mature heights of 40-50 feet, meeting the definition of large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F). Two such trees are located 0-5 feet from the overhead electric line on the southern boundary. Minimum 25-foot clearance for large trees from distribution conductors is required; proposed placement violates this requirement by 20-25 feet.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric infrastructure area (poles not clearly marked)
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows overhead electric (OHE) line along southern property boundary but utility poles are not clearly marked or designated on the sheet. Without pole locations, compliance with the 10-foot clearance requirement from tree trunks to poles cannot be verified. Indicate utility pole locations on the landscape plan.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan identifying trees near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows tree symbols (circles with designations M, SY, PL, P for mitigation, street yard, parking lot, and buffer trees) but does not label specific species on the landscape plan drawing. Mitigation trees (M) near the overhead electric line cannot be confirmed to specific species from the landscape plan alone; species identification requires cross-reference to plant schedule. A legend or label on the landscape plan identifying the species of trees near utilities would improve verifiability.

applicableAreas: Proposed shade trees and ornamental trees on landscape and grading plans
findings.comment: Plant schedule (Sheet 35) lists proposed trees with installation sizes (e.g., 4-inch caliper, 16-foot height at planting) but does NOT provide mature height specifications required to identify large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F). Landscape plan (Sheet 31) uses symbols (M, SY, PL, P) but does not differentiate or label which proposed trees will reach 40+ feet at maturity. Mature height information must be added to allow verification of large tree clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary within 15 feet of overhead electric distribution line
findings.comment: Cedar Elm and Live Oak trees are proposed 0-5 feet from the overhead electric line, within the prohibited clearance zone. No documented written approval from Austin Energy is provided in the application materials (Project Review Form, Master Comment Report, or supplementary documents) authorizing placement of trees in these prohibited zones. Obtain explicit written approval from Austin Energy or relocate trees to comply with minimum clearance distances.
